head.title: Santosh Boutique | Ladies Fashion & Custom Tailoring Bilaspur (HP)

meta.content: Santosh Boutique in Fatoh, Ghumarwin, Bilaspur (HP) near Baba Balak Nath Temple - 174021. Designer bridal blouses, custom suit stitching, lehenga tailoring & express alteration services. Call +91 94181 03213.

meta.content: Exquisite bespoke tailoring, designer bridal blouses & master alterations in Fatoh, Ghumarwin, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh.
